headline: European Natural Gas Prices Rise Amid Middle East Escalation
summary: European benchmark natural gas prices rose to nearly 90 euros per megawatt-hour as Middle East escalation raised concerns about winter gas supply during historically low inventories.
why: The Dutch TTF is the benchmark pricing hub for natural gas in Europe, heavily influencing regional energy costs and utility expenses.
why_moved: Escalation in the Middle East raised concerns about European winter gas supply amid historically low inventories at the start of the heating season.
